_evidence: 0x0051c690: 'movzx ebx, word [0x34b*2 + 0x9e1b20]' (= word 0x9e21b6), 'cmp bx,-1; je' skips; otherwise esi = edi = dword [0x6975ec + ebx] and 0x10000 bytes are rewritten in place (lodsb; sub al,0xf; shr al,2; stosb; loop). The word is the byte offset of a 0x20-byte entry of the texture table 0x6975ec (0x51c058 copies 0x20-byte entries with rep movsb, bounded by 0x6b35ec, and stores edi-0x6975ec in 0x9e1b20[]; 0x51bfb6 resets every word to 0xffff), so it is 0xffff or k*0x20; entries 0..2 are drawn. Entry +0 is the pointer to the 64 KiB map (0 in the image, so each is supplied as a distinct 0x10000-byte random buffer: the loop touches exactly 0x10000 bytes from it).
